THANKSGIVING ARTICLE QUESTIONS
Part 1: Reading comprehension questions
1. Why did the author feel uncomfortable during Thanksgiving celebrations at 
elementary school?
2. What was the significance of the first Thanksgiving in 1621, according to the article?
3. How did the Wampanoag people help the Pilgrims survive?
4. Why did the relationship between Indigenous peoples and European settlers 
eventually deteriorate?
5. What does the author suggest people should do to make Thanksgiving more 
meaningful?
Part 2: Discussion questions
1. Do you think schools should change the way they teach children about Thanksgiving? 
Why or why not?
2. How important is it for modern societies to acknowledge historical injustices, even 
when they happened hundreds of years ago?
